normalized.title: New Method Uses Physics to Identify Valuable Biodiversity Communities
normalized.summary: Conservationists understandably devote much time and energy to protecting endangered species such as the snow leopard, the black rhino, and the mountain gorilla. However scientists have found that biodiversity cannot be preserved in a single unique species.
